seo.title: How to plan a team welcome lunch
seo.description: Sample post: pick a team welcome lunch spot the whole team can reach, book it a week ahead and settle the place together without a long thread.

posts.body:
*Sample copy for local development. The real post comes from the Control Panel.*

A team welcome lunch works best at a place the whole team can reach in one trip, close to the office and easy to book for a group. Pick it a week ahead so the new teammate knows the plan before their first day.

This post covers where to hold the lunch, how far ahead to book and how to settle the place with your team. The examples are in New York.

## Where should a team welcome lunch be?

Pick a place near the office or near a station most of the team already uses. In New York, Grand Central and Rockefeller Center put many subway lines within a short walk.

## How far ahead should you book a team welcome lunch?

Book at least a week ahead for a group of seven or more. Ask whether the place holds a table for a big group at lunchtime, and whether it splits the bill.

## How long should the lunch take?

Plan for about an hour. A set menu or counter service gets everyone back to work on time.

## How to do it in Where2Meet

1. Start from the Team meeting chip on the homepage.
2. Share the link so everyone adds where they are coming from.
3. Compare travel times, vote, and the organizer picks the place.

## Common questions

### Should the new teammate pick the place?

Ask them which food they like, and let the organizer handle the booking.

## A quick checklist

- Book a week ahead.
- Check the table fits the whole team.
- Send the address and the nearest station the day before.

cities.intro:
*Sample copy for local development. The real intro comes from the Control Panel.*

New York is easy to reach and hard to agree on. A group spread across Brooklyn, Queens and Manhattan can spend longer choosing a place than getting there. These posts collect places that work for common plans, chosen so most people can arrive on one subway line.
cities.transit_notes:
*Sample copy.* Most trips here are by **subway**. A place within a short walk of a station served by several lines, like Herald Square or Times Square, is usually the most convenient pick for a mixed group.

- Check weekend service changes before you send the plan.
- Allow extra time for crossing between boroughs at rush hour.

seo.description: Sample post: group dinner spots near Herald Square that a big group can reach on one train, with tips on booking and getting home late.

posts.body:
*Sample copy for local development. The real post comes from the Control Panel.*

The easiest group dinner spots in New York sit next to a station where many subway lines stop, like Herald Square. Everyone gets there on one train, and nobody faces a long trip home after dinner.

This post covers where to look around Herald Square, how to book for a big group and how to settle the place together.

## Why is Herald Square easy to reach?

The 34th St-Herald Sq station serves the B, D, F, M, N, Q, R and W, and PATH trains stop next door.

![](herald-square-plaza-new-york.jpg)

## Where can a big group eat near Herald Square?

Koreatown is a short walk east, with restaurants built for sharing.

:::places

## How late do trains run after dinner?

The subway runs all night, but trains come less often after midnight. Check the trip home before you book a late table.

![](times-square-crowds-new-york.jpg)

## How to do it in Where2Meet

1. Start from the Group dinner chip on the homepage.
2. Share the link so everyone adds where they are coming from.
3. Compare travel times and vote on a place.

## Common questions

### Do Koreatown restaurants take bookings for big groups?

Many do. Call ahead for a group of eight or more.

towns.intro:
*Sample copy for local development.*

Midtown is where many New York offices are, so it's the default for anything work-related. Grand Central, Times Square and Herald Square stations put most of the city within one train, and Bryant Park sits between them as an easy landmark.
towns.transit_notes: *Sample copy.* Grand Central, Times Square and Herald Square stations serve most subway lines, and PATH and commuter trains stop nearby. Streets are busiest from 8 to 10 a.m. and 5 to 7 p.m.

seo.title: Quiet places for a small team meeting in Midtown
seo.description: Sample post: quiet, low-cost places in Midtown for a small team to meet over a weekday lunch, near stations your whole team can reach.

posts.body:
*Sample copy for local development. The real post comes from the Control Panel.*

Quiet places for a small team meeting in Midtown are a short walk from Grand Central and Bryant Park, so most of the team arrives on one train. A library reading room or a park table works for an informal check-in, and a coworking room works when you need a screen.

This post covers where to sit, when to go and how to agree on the place.

## Where can a small team meet quietly in Midtown?

Bryant Park and the library next to it are the easiest picks.

![](bryant-park-from-one-vanderbilt.jpg)

## Which places take bookings?

A coworking space rents rooms by the hour.

:::places

## When is Midtown quietest?

Late morning and early afternoon, between the rush hours.

![](grand-central-concourse-windows.jpg)

## How to do it in Where2Meet

1. Start from the Team meeting chip on the homepage.
2. Share the link and compare everyone's travel time.

## Common questions

### Can we talk in the library?

Keep to the areas where talking is allowed, and save the reading rooms for quiet work.

seo.title: A team welcome lunch in Bryant Park
seo.description: Sample post: welcome a new teammate with a relaxed weekday lunch in Bryant Park, easy to reach from most Midtown offices by subway.

posts.body:
*Sample copy for local development. The real post comes from the Control Panel.*

A team welcome lunch in Bryant Park is easy to reach from most Midtown offices, and the kiosks let everyone buy their own food. The movable chairs fit a big group without a booking.

This post covers where to sit, what to do if it rains and how to settle the plan.

## Where should the team sit in Bryant Park?

The lawn and the terrace by the library have the most chairs.

![](midtown-view-from-empire-state-building.jpg)

## What if it rains?

Book a room nearby as a backup.

:::places

## How do people get to Bryant Park?

The B, D, F and M stop at the park's corner, and the 7 stops at Fifth Avenue.

## How to do it in Where2Meet

1. Start from the Team meeting chip on the homepage.
2. Share the link and vote on the plan.

## Common questions

### Do we need a permit?

Not for a small, informal lunch at the park's public tables.
